```{r}
install.packages("openxlsx")
library("openxlsx")

data <- read.xlsx("~/Downloads/incendios-florestais-em-areas-protegidas-boi-areas-protegidas-2019-marco.xlsx", sheet = 1)

data$DataHoraDeteccao <- convertToDate(data$DataHoraDeteccao)
data$DataDeteccao <- convertToDate(data$DataDeteccao)
data$InicioCombate <- convertToDate(data$InicioCombate)
data$TerminoCombate <- convertToDate(data$TerminoCombate)
```

```{r}
install.packages("dplyr")
library(dplyr)

install.packages("lubridate")
library(lubridate)

agg_df <- data |> group_by(month_year=floor_date(DataDeteccao, "month")) |> summarise(qty = n_distinct(NumBOI))
```
```{r}
y <- ts(agg_df[,2], start=c(2019,1), frequency = 12)
```

```{r}
n_months = 4 
ts.plot(y, xlab="month_year", ylab="qty"); abline(v = time(y)[seq(n_months, length(y), by = n_months)], col = "red", lty = 3)
```

```{r}
ts.plot(diff(y), xlab="month_year", ylab="qty")
```

```{r}
acf(diff(y))
pacf(diff(y))
```
ARIMA(2,1,2) com sazonalidade a cada 4 meses.

```{r}
arima_model <- arima(diff(y), order=c(2,1,2))
acf(arima_model$residuals)
```
